title: fix(security)!: a hook that runs as system and an action body write no identity assignment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQXftB7pSBetnK4NoZD2gaR)_

Part of #25653

Clause-②: no (narrowing: app-authored hook and action-script writes to the four identity objects are refused at run time, as #25251 did for flows; the seat runs the contract review before the queue)
Metadata-protocol: none

The run-time half of the card. The save-time half (refusing at registration a hook or action body that names one of the four objects under system elevation, with its ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry) is `domain:spec` work, pointed to on #6017; the card stays open for it.

## What changed

The #25251 refusal reads `isSystem` AND `flowRunId`. Two other app-authored elevations carry `isSystem` and no run, so it did not see them: a hook's `runAs: 'system'` api, and an action body's `ctx.api` / `ctx.engine`. Each is now derived with a provenance mark, and the one predicate reads it.

| Context | Governed write to `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member` | Reads of the four | Writes to other objects |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runAs: 'system'` hook (sandboxed body or in-process handler) | **refused, PERMISSION_DENIED** (was: admitted past every gate) | admitted | admitted |
| action body, `ctx.api` or `ctx.engine` | **refused, PERMISSION_DENIED** (was: admitted past every gate) | admitted | admitted |
| `runAs: 'system'` flow | refused, word for word as before | admitted | admitted |
| `runAs: 'user'` hook | not judged here; the ordinary gates judge the user it acts for | per the user | per the user |
| platform `sudo()`, bare `{ isSystem: true }` writers | admitted, unchanged (no mark) | admitted | admitted |

- `@objectstack/core`, new `security/app-automation-elevation.ts`: the mark is a registry symbol (`Symbol.for`, so the ESM and CJS builds agree) with `markAppAutomationElevation`, `appAutomationElevationOf` and `carryAppAutomationElevation`. A symbol cannot be spelled by a request body or a stored row, so no caller can claim or shed it. It lives in core because it is the one package objectql, runtime and plugin-security all depend on (the reasoning `operation-private-keys.ts` gives).
- `objectql` `ScopedContext.withRunAs('system')` builds the `sudo()`-shaped context plus the `'hook'` mark. `sudo()` itself is untouched.
- `runtime` `buildActionExecutionContext` adds the `'action'` mark; `buildActionApi`'s malformed-envelope fallback now goes through the same builder.
- `objectql` `createContext` carries the mark across `ExecutionContextSchema.parse`. The parse keeps declared keys only, and an action body's `ctx.api` is built through it, so without the carry the body's `ctx.api` writes reached the refusal unmarked (measured: `ctx.engine` was refused and `ctx.api` was not).
- `plugin-security` `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`: the predicate is now `isSystem` AND (`flowRunId` OR the mark), in a new `elevationSource` helper. A context carrying both a run and a mark is answered as the flow, so a system flow's refusal is byte-identical. Each source names itself and its fix: a hook sets `runAs: 'user'`; an action body has no `runAs`, so its grant moves to a `runAs: 'user'` flow, which an action of type `flow` runs as the invoking user; invitations and memberships use the organization endpoints. No second module, no new error code.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 1b covers the family; its anchor moves to `#elevationSource`, where the `isSystem` read now sits (`check-system-context-census` exit 0).
- Comment only: the middleware's call-site comment in `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`.
- Changeset: the four packages `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`), BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Measured before any code (card condition 1)

On `main` `cb0a2fcf`, real `ObjectQL` + SQL driver + `SecurityPlugin` + QuickJS, a plain member as the trigger or caller:

- a `runAs: 'system'` hook, as an L2 body and as an in-process handler, wrote each of the four objects (positions and grants with `granted_by` null);
- an L2 action body wrote each of the four objects;
- an **L1 expression** action body cannot reach `ctx` at all, so it writes nothing. Per condition 1 that sub-path is reported as a fork, not fixed;
- control: the same member's direct writes are refused `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

Census: no hook, action body or host action handler in objectstack (`packages/`, `examples/`, `apps/`) or HotCRM writes the four objects; the writers on `main` are platform code with their own system contexts. Nothing shipped starts being refused.

## Tests

- New `runtime/src/app-automation-identity-write-refusal.integration.test.ts` (50 cases), real engine, driver, security middleware and QuickJS, store read back past the middleware:
  - `runAs: 'system'` hook, body and handler × four objects × insert/update/delete: refused with `code`, `status`, source and prescription; the store does not move and the triggering write aborts;
  - action body `ctx.api` × four × three verbs, and `ctx.engine` per object: the same;
  - controls: the same hook writes another object; the same body reads the four and writes another object; the hook under `runAs: 'user'` is refused by the ordinary gates, not by this refusal; a `sudo()` derived from a user context and a platform system context insert, update and delete all four.
  - **Red first** (commit `7bb83a96`, before the fix): 40 refusal cases failed, 10 controls passed.
- `plugin-security` refusal test: the predicate for both marks over every `GOVERNED_OPERATIONS` verb on each object, run-plus-mark answered as the flow, the mark without `isSystem` not judged, an unknown mark value read as none. PR1's cases unchanged and green.
- `core` `app-automation-elevation.test.ts` (6): symbol identity, fresh copy, spread survival, JSON cannot spell it, dropped by the parse and carried across it.
- `runtime/action-body-identity.test.ts`: two `toEqual({ isSystem: true })` pins now include the mark, plus one case that the builder carries it.

Pins describe behaviour only.

## Verification

All at head `a8b13e57`, under the verify lock:

- `pnpm test` per package, each VERDICT `command-exit 0`: core 119 files / 2763 passed; plugin-security 223 files / 4683 passed, 45 skipped; objectql 467 files / 8718 passed; runtime 445 files / 7151 passed, 19 skipped.
- `pnpm typecheck` in the same four packages: exit 0 each, including `check:test-typecheck` where the package has it.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 10 changed TypeScript files: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 108 families): 108 exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). Four answered a prerequisite on the first pass and exit 0 after it was met: `check-engine-split-ratio` (shallow clone, deepened with `--shallow-since`), and `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` (full `turbo run build`).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one behaviour: the predicate's read of the mark, `elevationSource`), with the marker proven in `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight` before the readings, because the runtime suite reads plugin-security from `dist/`:
  - runtime pin: 40 failed, 10 passed. The 40 are exactly the hook and action refusal cases; every control stays green.
  - plugin-security pin: 48 failed, 47 passed. The 48 are the two marks × four objects × six verbs; PR1's flow cases and the controls stay green.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, marker absent from `dist/`, both pins green again (50/50, 95/95).
  - A first attempt was a no-op: its marker was a comment, which the build strips, so the preflight refused it before any reading. The second used a marker that survives the build.
- Full dogfood battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm): running at head `a8b13e57` when this PR was opened; its counts go in the `os-dev-report` on #25653.

## Acceptance notes

- Claimed surface, declared departures: `packages/core/src/security/` (new module, barrel export, test), `objectql` `createContext` (the carry, beside the claimed `withRunAs`), the middleware call-site comment, and the two pin updates in `action-body-identity.test.ts`. No `packages/spec/**`, and `sudo()` is unchanged.
- `buildActionExecutionContext` serves every handler an action door dispatches, host code handlers included, so a host handler's writes to the four objects are refused too. The census found none.
- `ObjectRepository.execute()` (the third `executeAction` caller) elevates with `{ ...context, isSystem: true }` and is not one of the two ruled derivation sites, so an action reached that way from an unmarked context runs unmarked. The sandbox does not expose `execute`, so only host code reaches it. Noted, not changed.
- The mark is an undeclared, in-process context key rather than an `ExecutionContext` field, because this PR may not touch `packages/spec`. Declaring it there is an option for the spec half; see the report on #25653.
- Branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-hg746g`; the claim comment is the identity record.
